errorCodes.meaning: No account is linked to the caller's DID on this forge — the answer for any caller with nothing linked, member or not — or `accountId` was given and the account linked there now is a different one.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ForgeAccount.description: A person's account on one forge. `id` is authoritative; `login` is for display only, because logins can be renamed and re-registered.

login.description: The account's current login, as the forge reported it when last seen. Display only.

ForgeAccount.title: ForgeAccount

ForgeHost.description: The lowercased DNS host of a forge: `github.com`, a GitHub Enterprise Server host, `codeberg.org`, or a self-hosted Forgejo instance such as `git.example.org`. No scheme, no port, no path. The host is a segment of every resource, so a right never crosses forges.
ForgeHost.title: ForgeHost

ForgeId.description: An identifier the forge itself assigns — a repository id, a user or organisation id — carried as a string so a forge whose ids are not numbers needs no new version. GitHub and Forgejo ids are decimal integers written as strings (`"812736451"`). Unlike a name, it survives renames and transfers, which is why rights and bindings are keyed by it.
ForgeId.title: ForgeId

Response.description: The account that was unlinked, and when.

unlinked.description: The account that is no longer linked to the member's DID.

schema.description: A member removes the binding between their DID and their account on one forge, made with git-ns/account/link. The VTC deletes it and re-projects, so the bridge withdraws the forge roles it gave that account.

accountId.description: The forge id of the account the member means to unlink, as they last read it. When present, the VTC unlinks only if this is the account linked on `forge` now, so a request made before a re-link cannot remove the account linked since.

forge.description: The forge whose linked account to unlink.

schema.title: Git Namespaces — Unlink Forge Account — payload
